warehouse/30170-noteach.htm.text: Warehouse Keeper Radic: It looks like you've come to the wrong place, adventurer. I'm a warehouse keeper, which means I only teach Scavengers and Bounty Hunters. Why don't you look for a mentor better suited to your profession?
